list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (cross-checked by PlanetGTA6) and by GamesRadar+ / PowerPyx (cross-checked by GameMapa).

Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

roadmap.time: About 200 hours in one playthrough (PowerPyx, via GameMapa)

phases.title: Story and side missions
phases.text: Play through the story and pick up optional missions as they appear. Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars as you go — the 100% checklist later wants 200 of the 277 base vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals studied, and everything done before the ending already counts.

phases.title: The 100% checklist and Challenges
phases.text: After the ending, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry. You need every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest; only 70 of the 80 Challenges are needed, so skip the nastiest ones.

phases.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
phases.text: The checklist does not ask for these quests, so they are usually what is left afterwards, together with any stray trophies that did not pop on their own.

roadmap.saveAdvice: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a separate manual save at the start and end of every chapter — 10 slots covers it, with 5 left to rotate in free roam after the ending. Cheats disable trophies and saving, and only unlock after the story, so keep them off your platinum save.
roadmap.missableNote: Only one trophy is flagged as possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude. One meditation, with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, is only available in Chapter 1 and is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, so do it when it is offered.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task, no multiplayer and no DLC needed. Work through the roadmap below and this is the last trophy you will hear.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening mission, and it pops at the end of the mission. This is the first trophy most players will earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: play through every Chapter 1 mission to the chapter's end. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one-time Lucia balcony meditation at Jason's house — it is the only step in the whole list that can be missed (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every Chapter 2 mission. The Trust trophy (Breakfast Run) also unlocks during this chapter, so keep an eye out for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every Chapter 3 mission. Andy's questline for Lucia and the Snap Gun you need for the Sneakthief trophy both open up around this chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every Chapter 4 mission. Three more story trophies pop in this chapter — Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked — all by playing the missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable and the only gold tied to the story: finish the final mission. After the ending, free roam opens up and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats — that is where the long cleanup phase of the roadmap begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2. Just follow the mission markers; there is no side objective to worry about.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3. Heist missions are linear, so play it through and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as the story reaches it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the Headliners mission in Chapter 4. Another mission trophy that needs no preparation — just play the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4. The airport setting here is the same one the Catch Me If You Can trophy uses later, so you will already know your way around VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5. It is the last of the 12 story trophies, and it pops as the story reaches it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the last gold before the platinum. After the ending, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion checklist — finish everything on it. It is closer to 60% of the game's true content: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is. Plan on about 100 hours for this phase alone.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida: stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. You only need about two-thirds of them, so skip the ones that keep beating you and use the in-game stunt markers to find fresh ones. This also counts toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them needs a win or a score — just start each one once, and the trophy pops on the ninth.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges across the 12 Shooting Ranges. Unlike most trophies here, silver or bronze will not do — every challenge needs gold. Work range by range, learn each weapon's recoil pattern, and leave the hardest challenges for after you have upgraded your weapons. Every range is also needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so a win anywhere counts once — work through the map location by location and tick them off in the checklist. Drone races are also part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Repeating a race you already won does not count — each win has to be a race you have not won before. Pick the vehicle classes you are strongest in first and save the awkward ones for last.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His questline starts in Chapter 1, so meet him early and follow his fishing contests — the challenge itself is a straight fishing contest against him, so bring your best rod and mind the tension on the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade video games — three of them are on the TV at home, so you do not even have to travel. Pick the game you find easiest, finish a full run of it, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5 quests — Lucia only, starting from Chapter 3 — and complete his final mission, Puff Puff Pass. Side-character strands unlock as the story opens new chapters, so check back for Andy's next quest marker each time a chapter ends.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear 7 shipwrecks for Kenton, starting from Chapter 1, and finish his final mission. The wrecks are underwater dives, so bring scuba gear and take your time — each wreck is its own dive site, and the count carries across sessions.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, starting from Chapter 2, and complete his final mission. Mudclub quests are vehicle-heavy, so keep a sturdy off-roader handy when his marker appears.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a small questline for a stranger — a single mission does not count, you have to see a strand through to its end. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so finish the ones you enjoy and skip the rest.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List, starting from Chapter 3, and finish his final mission. Each car on the list is a specific model in a specific condition — read the list carefully before you go hunting, and deliver them one at a time as you find them.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's last quest — Jason only, starting from Chapter 3. The lab raids are combat-heavy, so stock up on armour and ammo before each one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as such. After an early Chapter 1 mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and heads out to the balcony: follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. That balcony meditation raises the counter in the Progress menu but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and it cannot be done again after Chapter 1 — so do it the moment it is offered, before you finish the chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason only. Bret's quests are part of the 100% checklist, so do not skip them. The exact animal is still being confirmed by the guides, so follow Bret's quest markers and take the shot when the unique animal is marked for you.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of the 18 in the game. Cards are found across Leonida — in shops, in the world and as mission rewards — so collect as you travel and trade duplicates where you can. You only need 3 full sets, not all 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the app whenever you pass somewhere new — the scan is quick, and the same habit also feeds the Whip It Good trophy, since scanning a new vehicle counts as discovering it. Work region by region so you do not miss clusters.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Challenges are small feats across combat, driving, flying and the open world — most pop naturally while you play, and you only need 50 of 80, so chase the easy ones first and leave the grindy ones until the cleanup phase. Only 70 of the 80 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is a stepping stone to that one.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat zone. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow you along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It often pops by itself, since robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level in between — the wanted level has to stay live across all three. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well: hit them in quick succession, keep moving, and do not let the heat drop. The trophy is delayed and pops about half a minute after you leave the third store.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a WAiNK scan of a new vehicle is enough, you do not have to drive or own it. Scan every new vehicle you pass on the street and in traffic, and this pops long before you have seen half of Leonida's 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Prepare first: buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick a fight with gang members at one of their illegal operations, where enemies bunch up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly it away. The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4 at VCIA — board it, get it moving, and the trophy unlocks once you are 1 km away from the airport. Expect a wanted level the moment you take it, so fly low and fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station. The base is guarded, so go in with a plan: a fast approach vehicle, armour, and a route out. Once you are rolling in the Rhino, the trophy pops — and the army will notice, so do not linger.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which only becomes available from Chapter 3, so do not attempt this early. Go in quiet, take the goods without tripping the alarm or the cameras, and leave before anyone raises the alert — one spotted guard ruins the run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault robberies are the biggest heists in free roam — plan the getaway before you go in, and remember that a vault robbery instantly puts you at a 4-star wanted level, which is also how the Hot Together trophy tends to pop. All 5 vaults are needed for 100% completion too.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and get clear of the wanted level. One successful escape is all it takes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the state, including the small islands and back roads; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last patch of fog lifts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.target: One operation per gang, 9 gangs, 39 operations
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist across Leonida, so you have plenty to choose from. Hit the easiest operation of each gang and move on; you do not need all 39, just one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger for this hidden trophy is still unconfirmed — the guides list its condition as unknown. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; the community is still pinning down which spot and moment makes it pop, so check the cited guides for the latest findings.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a nod to the series' most famous entrance. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guides, so the honest advice is: take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass, the way the old games did it, and watch for the pop. Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. It is a small robbery with a bowling theme: grab the three valuables inside, get out, and shake the wanted level to make it pop.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Go to the gym together: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles. Keep both of them training until both Strength stats are maxed and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. This is a long grind that ticks up as you play — crimes, choices and consequences all feed the profile. Play normally, check the counter in the Progress menu from time to time, and it will pop in the late game; avoid the Irredeemable profile rating, which is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guides, so the honest advice is to retry a failed stunt or challenge and succeed on the second go; check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method rather than guessing.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description hints at witnessing something strange. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed — the guides list this as one of five unsolved hidden trophies. Explore Leonida's odd corners and easter-egg spots; when the community confirms the trigger, the cited guides will carry it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed by the guides, so the working method is a drive-by swing at a pedestrian from a slow-moving car; check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Marked Bills come from robberies — take them to a fence and launder them in batches. It adds up across the whole game, so keep laundering after every big score instead of letting the bills pile up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so it ticks up on its own as you gear up. If you are short at the end, buy and sell expensive items or stock up on ammo and armour to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale as you explore and earn — buy each one when you can afford it, since they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are collecting for Whip It Good and On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat for 10 different vehicles. It pairs naturally with buying garages and discovering vehicles for the other collection trophies.
